says: In today's CI, two clauses of host.yaml's H9 rule, no job-level continue-on-error on p8 (host.ts:158) and no if on the P8 law step (host.ts:163), have no plant in host.test.ts, so either can be deleted with every test still green.
proof: In a scratch copy of .github/ci/workflow-lint with host.yaml, deleting `p8["continue-on-error"] === undefined &&` from host.ts and running host.test.ts with vitest 5.0.5 on Node 26.13.0 printed 'Tests 42 passed (42)'; deleting `p8Run?.["if"] === undefined &&` also printed 'Tests 42 passed (42)'. The only continue-on-error plant for p8 is on the step (host.test.ts:291-295).
cost: A later edit that drops either clause passes review and CI, and a p8 job with continue-on-error: true or a skipped law step would then report a green proof run for a red or unrun P8.
